title: AI turned makers into reviewers.
text: People no longer do three or four tasks a day; they review twenty. The constant small wins wear down attention in a way you don't feel while working.

title: Burnout arrives off the clock.
text: It shows up on a Sunday evening, not during the work, and replacing a burned-out teammate costs about six months of salary. Teams sandbox their agents carefully and set no limits for themselves.

title: Claude Code can run your life admin.
text: On a fixed $100 a month, one personal agent built on Claude Code handled an insurance claim, a homeowners' association dispute and a business buyout in a single week.

title: People learn new environments by testing hypotheses.
text: Given a puzzle current AI can't solve and no instructions, people solved it by proposing a rule, testing it and revising it on a partial picture of the world.

title: That's what today's AI is missing.
text: Neural networks transfer skills well but adapt badly to unfamiliar settings. Flexible AI needs hypothesis testing built in.
